decision_conditions: The proposed internally illuminated fascia sign and projecting sign, by reason of their siting, scale, illumination, design and colour, would appear visually intrusive and unsympathetic to the historic shopfront, resulting in less than substantial harm to the character and appearance of the Enfield Town Conservation Area. In particular, the projecting sign would be sited outside the defined signable area and would obscure architectural features, while the internally illuminated signage and high-contrast colour scheme would appear obtrusive and incongruous within the street scene. The harm identified is not outweighed by any public benefits. The proposal is therefore unacceptable and contrary to Chapter 16 of the NPPF (2024), Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021) Policies DMD 41 and 44 of the Development Management Document (2014) and the Enfield Town Conservation Area Character Appraisal (2015).
description: Installation of internally illuminated fascia and projecting sign.
